description: Render chart templates to an output directory or as text of concatenated yaml documents.

parameters.name: binary_path
parameters.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

parameters.name: chart_ref
parameters.description: Chart reference with repo prefix, for example, nginx-stable/nginx-ingress. Path to a packaged chart. Path to an unpacked chart directory. Absolute URL.

parameters.name: chart_repo_url
parameters.description: Chart repository URL where the requested chart is located.

parameters.name: chart_version
parameters.description: Chart version to use. If this is not specified, the latest version is installed.

parameters.name: dependency_update
parameters.description: Run helm dependency update before the operation. The dependency_update option require the add of dependencies block in Chart.yaml/requirements.yaml file. For more information please visit https://helm.sh/docs/helm/helm_dependency/ Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: disable_hook
parameters.description: Prevent hooks from running during install. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: include_crds
parameters.description: Include custom resource descriptions in rendered templates. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: insecure_registry
parameters.description: Skip TLS certificate checks for the chart download Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Output directory where templates will be written. If the directory already exists, it will be overwritten.

parameters.name: plain_http
parameters.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when working with OCI registries Requires Helm >= 3.13.0 Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: release_name
parameters.description: Release name to use in rendered templates.

parameters.name: release_values
parameters.description: Values to pass to chart. Default: {}

parameters.name: set_values
parameters.description: Values to pass to chart configuration.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to pass to chart configuration (e.g phase=prod).

parameters.name: value_type
parameters.description: Use raw set individual value. Use string to force a string for an individual value. Use file to set individual values from a file when the value itself is too long for the command line or is dynamically generated. Use json to set json values (scalars/objects/arrays). This feature requires helm>=3.10.0. Choices: "raw" ← (default) "string" "json" "file"

parameters.name: show_only
parameters.description: Only show manifests rendered from the given templates. Default: []

parameters.name: update_repo_cache
parameters.description: Run helm repo update before the operation. Can be run as part of the template generation or as a separate step. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: values_files
parameters.description: Value files to pass to chart. Paths will be read from the target host’s filesystem, not the host running ansible. values_files option is evaluated before values option if both are used. Paths are evaluated in the order the paths are specified. Default: []

examples:
- name: Render templates to specified directory
  kubernetes.core.helm_template:
    chart_ref: stable/prometheus
    output_dir: mycharts

- name: Render templates
  kubernetes.core.helm_template:
    chart_ref: stable/prometheus
  register: result

- name: Write templates to file
  copy:
    dest: myfile.yaml
    content: "{{ result.stdout }}"

- name: Render MutatingWebhooksConfiguration for revision tag "canary", rev "1-13-0"
  kubernetes.core.helm_template:
    chart_ref: istio/istiod
    chart_version: "1.13.0"
    release_namespace: "istio-system"
    show_only:
      - "templates/revision-tags.yaml"
    release_values:
      revision: "1-13-0"
      revisionTags:
        - "canary"
  register: result

- name: Write templates to file
  copy:
    dest: myfile.yaml
    content: "{{ result.stdout }}"

return_values.name: command
return_values.description: Full helm command run by this module, in case you want to re-run the command outside the module or debug a problem. Returned: always Sample: "helm template --output-dir mychart nginx-stable/nginx-ingress"

return_values.name: stderr
return_values.description: Full helm command stderr, in case you want to display it or examine the event log. Returned: always Sample: ""

return_values.name: stdout
return_values.description: Full helm command stdout. If no output_dir has been provided this will contain the rendered templates as concatenated yaml documents. Returned: always Sample: ""
